title: Natansh Bhamba (Centscape): full-circle moment meeting Eric at SkyDeck
summary: Centscape co-founder reflects on how Lean Startup methodology shaped Centscape's operating discipline, and meeting Eric through SkyDeck closed the loop.
blockquote: Meeting Eric Ries through Berkeley SkyDeck felt like a full circle moment. The thinking that once shaped how I understood startups is now embedded in how we operate every week at Centscape.
